svg.title: A delicate balance — an anteater circus act
svg.desc: A long-snouted, bushy-tailed anteater wearing a red neckerchief pedals a teal unicycle and continuously flips three colorful bottles through the air. A warm, illustrated circus poster with a seamless 3.6-second loop. Reduced-motion preferences show a still illustration.

g.text: ONE WHEEL. THREE BOTTLES. NO PROBLEM.
